plugins.name: oncue
plugins.description: OnCue: explainer Shorts where every word lands on cue. Storyboard a topic, voice it with ElevenLabs, and render a native PowerPoint deck and an animated MP4, vertical 9:16 for YouTube Shorts, Reels and TikTok or widescreen 16:9 for YouTube, or a custom size within the supported limits, all from one short.json spec.
